ENV.update(PYSTACHY_HOME=str(ROOT),PYSTACHY_LLVM=LLVM,PYSTACHY_JOBS='2',PY=PY,PATH=LLVM+':'+ENV['PATH'])
def run(name,command,extra=None,expected=0):
    start=time.monotonic()
    p=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,env=ENV|(extra or {}),text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=300)
    result=dict(command=command,environment=extra or {},returncode=p.returncode,stdout=p.stdout,stderr=p.stderr,wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,expected_exit=expected)
    (OUT/(name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(name,p.returncode,p.stdout[-700:],p.stderr[-200:],flush=True)
    assert p.returncode==expected
    return result
files=['tests/tuple_return_closures.py','tests/tuple_return_values.py']
configs=[('native',str(COMPILER),{}),('gc',str(COMPILER),{'PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS_PROGRAM':'1'}),('noopt',str(COMPILER),{'PYSTACHY_OPT':'-all'}),('no-tupleret',str(COMPILER),{'PYSTACHY_OPT':'-tupleret'}),('hosted',PY+' -m pystachy',{})]
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
    list(pool.map(lambda config:run(config[0],['tests/run.sh',config[1],'jit aot',*files],config[2]),configs))
for f in files:

run('ir',['tools/check_ir.sh',str(COMPILER),'tests/ir/tuple_return_closures.py','tests/ir/tuple_return.py'])

    calls=(ROOT/'tests/ir/tuple_return_closures.calls').read_text()
    p.with_suffix('.calls').write_text(''.join(line for line in calls.splitlines(keepends=True) if not line.startswith('@v.f.three:')))
    result=run('negative-contract',['tools/check_ir.sh',str(COMPILER),str(p)],expected=1)
